text:
```yaml
name: TS Audit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Apply Fern override to ignore x-session-access-key header
        run: |
          sed -i '/\/api\/v3\/tool_router\/session\//,/parameters:/ s/^.*"x-session-access-key": {.*$/&\n    "in": "header",\n    "x-fern-ignore": true,/' openapi.yaml

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add openapi.yaml
          git commit -m "Hide x-session-access-key header from API docs"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.7.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
```
